skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities that already have a common denominator by subtracting numerators, keeping the denominator, and simplifying or normalizing the fractional result when needed.

skills.name: Find LCD and convert fractions
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator for unlike denominators and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with that common denominator.

skills.name: Subtract mixed or whole numbers without regrouping
skills.definition: Decompose mixed or whole-number expressions into whole and fractional parts, subtract the whole-number parts, retain or subtract a nonnegative fractional part, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Regroup in mixed-number subtraction
skills.definition: When the fractional part of the minuend is too small, borrow one or more whole units as denominator-sized fractional units and combine the adjusted whole and fraction parts.
